items.source_en: The Partisan threat has ended. Saw Gerrera is dead, and any remaining partisans will ultimately join the Rebel Alliance in the fight against the Empire. Due to his contingency ensuring that all credits and designs from the secret Vakbeor project would be delivered directly to the Empire, I was forced to let him go.
